articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (" BioVie " or the " Company "), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced that it has entered into a securities purchase agreement with a single healthcare focused institutional investor for the purchase and sale of 2,962,500 shares of common stock (or common stock equivalents in lieu thereof) at a purchase price of $1.60 per share in a registered direct offering priced at-the-market under Nasdaq rules. In addition, in a concurrent private placement, the Company will issue and sell unregistered common warrants to purchase up to 2,962,500 shares of common stock (together with the registered direct offering, the “ Offering ”). articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced the Company has been invited to present a late-breaking oral presentation at the 4th Long COVID International Conference 2026 to be held in Nice, France from November 12-13, 2026. Dr. Penelope Markham, BioVie’s Senior Vice President and Program Lead for Long COVID, will share the presentation titled “Bezisterim Improves Fatigue, Post-Exertional Malaise, and Cognition in Prespecified High-Symptom-Burden Subgroups of the Phase 2 Randomized ADDRESS-LC Trial in Long COVID” during the “Session 8: Clinical Trials” session, starting 3:30 p.m. on Friday, November 13.
